name: Djomy

open_questions: Djomy's sign-up page (https://djomy.africa/register) asks for 'Nom de votre organisation', but neither djomy.africa nor developers.djomy.africa says whether an individual without a registered business can open a merchant account, nor which documents are required (developers.djomy.africa/legal answered 403).

description: Djomy is a Guinean payment solution offering payment links, QR code payments, and mobile money integrations via a unified API.
example_prompt: Add Djomy mobile money payments to my app.
